scripts.check:og: curl -sS --fail -D og-smoke.headers -o og-smoke.png "https://mihhailovski-product-designer.vercel.app/api/og?title=Smoke+test" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('og-smoke.headers','utf8');const s=fs.statSync('og-smoke.png').size;const ct=(h.split('\n').find(l=>l.toLowerCase().startsWith('content-type:'))||'content-type: ?').trim();const ok=ct.toLowerCase().includes('image/')&&s>1000;console.log((ok?'OG OK':'OG FAILED')+' - '+s+' bytes - '+ct);process.exit(ok?0:1)"
